verses.arabicText: صٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ذِى ٱلذِّكْرِ
verses.transliteration: Sad wal-qur'āni dhī dh-dhik'r
verses.translation: Sad. By the Qur'an containing reminder...

verses.arabicText: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى عِزَّةٍۢ وَشِقَاقٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Bali alladhīna kafarū fī ʿizzatiw-washiqāqin
verses.translation: But those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension.

verses.arabicText: كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍۢ فَنَادَوا۟ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Kam ahlaknā min qablihim min qarnin fanādaw walāta ḥīna manāṣin
verses.translation: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, and they [then] called out; but it was not a time for escape.

verses.arabicText: وَعَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ ۖ وَقَالَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا سَٰحِرٌۭ كَذَّابٌ
verses.transliteration: Waʿajibū an jāahum mundhirum-min'hum waqāla l-kāfirūna hādhā sāḥirun kadhābun
verses.translation: And they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, "This is a magician and a liar.

verses.arabicText: أَجَعَلَ ٱلْءَالِهَةَ إِلَٰهًۭا وَٰحِدًا ۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ عُجَابٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Ajaʿala l-ālihata ilāhaw-wāḥidan inna hādhā lashayon ʿujābun
verses.translation: Has he made the gods [only] one God? Indeed, this is a curious thing."

verses.arabicText: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱمْشُوا۟ وَٱصْبِرُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمْ ۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَىْءٌۭ يُرَادُ
verses.transliteration: Wa-inṭalaqa l-mala-u min'hum ani im'shū wa-iṣ'birū ʿalā ālihatikum inna hādhā lashayoy-yurād
verses.translation: And the eminent among them went forth, [saying], "Continue, and be patient over [the defense of] your gods. Indeed, this is a thing intended.

verses.arabicText: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَٰذَا فِى ٱلْمِلَّةِ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخْتِلَٰقٌ
verses.transliteration: Mā samiʿ'nā bihādhā fī l-milati l-ākhirati in hādhā illā ikh'tilāqun
verses.translation: We have not heard of this in the latest religion. This is not but a fabrication.

verses.arabicText: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ مِّن ذِكْرِى ۖ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِ
verses.transliteration: A-unzila ʿalayhi dh-dhik'ru min bayninā bal hum fī shakkim-min dhik'rī bal lammā yadhūqū ʿadhāb
verses.translation: Has the message been revealed to him out of [all of] us?" Rather, they are in doubt about My message. Rather, they have not yet tasted My punishment.

verses.arabicText: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْوَهَّابِ
verses.transliteration: Am ʿindahum khazāinu raḥmati rabbika l-ʿazīzi l-wahāb
verses.translation: Or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your Lord, the Exalted in Might, the Bestower?

verses.arabicText: أَمْ لَهُم مُّلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَلْيَرْتَقُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَسْبَٰبِ
verses.transliteration: Am lahum mul'ku s-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā falyartaqū fī l-asbāb
verses.translation: Or is theirs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend through [any] ways of access.

verses.arabicText: جُندٌۭ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ
verses.transliteration: Jundum-mā hunālika mahzūmum-mina l-aḥzāb
verses.translation: [They are but] soldiers [who will be] defeated there among the companies [of disbelievers].

verses.arabicText: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَعَادٌۭ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو ٱلْأَوْتَادِ
verses.transliteration: Kadhabat qablahum qawmu nūḥiw-waʿādun wafir'ʿawnu dhū l-awtād
verses.translation: The people of Noah denied before them, and [the tribe of] 'Aad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes,

verses.arabicText: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍۢ وَأَصْحَٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ
verses.transliteration: Wathamūdu waqawmu lūṭiw-wa-aṣḥābu al'aykati ulāika l-aḥzāb
verses.translation: And [the tribe of] Thamud and the people of Lot and the companions of the thicket. Those are the companies.

verses.arabicText: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
verses.transliteration: In kullun illā kadhaba r-rusula faḥaqqa ʿiqāb
verses.translation: Each of them denied the messengers, so My penalty was justified.

verses.arabicText: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Wamā yanẓuru hāulāi illā ṣayḥataw-wāḥidatan mā lahā min fawāqin
verses.translation: And these [disbelievers] await not but one blast [of the Horn]; for it there will be no delay.

verses.arabicText: وَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
verses.transliteration: Waqālū rabbanā ʿajjil lanā qiṭṭanā qabla yawmi l-ḥisāb
verses.translation: And they say, "Our Lord, hasten for us our share [of the punishment] before the Day of Account"

verses.arabicText: ٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلْأَيْدِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
verses.transliteration: Iṣ'bir ʿalā mā yaqūlūna wa-udh'kur ʿabdanā dāwūda dhā l-aydi innahu awwābun
verses.translation: Be patient over what they say and remember Our servant, David, the possessor of strength; indeed, he was one who repeatedly turned back [to Allah].

verses.arabicText: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
verses.transliteration: Innā sakharnā l-jibāla maʿahu yusabbiḥ'na bil-ʿashiyi wal-ish'rāq
verses.translation: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allah] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise.

verses.arabicText: وَٱلطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةًۭ ۖ كُلٌّۭ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Wal-ṭayra maḥshūratan kullul-lahu awwābun
verses.translation: And the birds were assembled, all with him repeating [praises].

verses.arabicText: وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهُۥ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ ٱلْخِطَابِ
verses.transliteration: Washadadnā mul'kahu waātaynāhu l-ḥik'mata wafaṣla l-khiṭāb
verses.translation: And We strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and discernment in speech.

verses.arabicText: ۞ وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ نَبَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَصْمِ إِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا۟ ٱلْمِحْرَابَ
verses.transliteration: Wahal atāka naba-u l-khaṣmi idh tasawwarū l-miḥ'rāb
verses.translation: And has there come to you the news of the adversaries, when they climbed over the wall of [his] prayer chamber -

verses.arabicText: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ دَاوُۥدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ خَصْمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعْضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْ وَٱهْدِنَآ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ
verses.transliteration: Idh dakhalū ʿalā dāwūda fafaziʿa min'hum qālū lā takhaf khaṣmāni baghā baʿḍunā ʿalā baʿḍin fa-uḥ'kum baynanā bil-ḥaqi walā tush'ṭiṭ wa-ih'dinā ilā sawāi ṣ-ṣirāṭ
verses.translation: When they entered upon David and he was alarmed by them? They said, "Fear not. [We are] two adversaries, one of whom has wronged the other, so judge between us with truth and do not exceed [it] and guide us to the sound path.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ هَٰذَآ أَخِى لَهُۥ تِسْعٌۭ وَتِسْعُونَ نَعْجَةًۭ وَلِىَ نَعْجَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ فَقَالَ أَكْفِلْنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِى فِى ٱلْخِطَابِ
verses.transliteration: Inna hādhā akhī lahu tis'ʿuw-watis'ʿūna naʿjataw-waliya naʿjatuw-wāḥidatun faqāla akfil'nīhā waʿazzanī fī l-khiṭāb
verses.translation: Indeed this, my brother, has ninety-nine ewes, and I have one ewe; so he said, 'Entrust her to me,' and he overpowered me in speech."

verses.arabicText: قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعْجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِۦ ۖ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْخُلَطَآءِ لَيَبْغِى بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَقَلِيلٌۭ مَّا هُمْ ۗ وَظَنَّ دَاوُۥدُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّٰهُ فَٱسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهُۥ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًۭا وَأَنَابَ ۩
verses.transliteration: Qāla laqad ẓalamaka bisuāli naʿjatika ilā niʿājihi wa-inna kathīram-mina l-khulaṭāi layabghī baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍin illā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū ṣ-ṣāliḥāti waqalīlum-mā hum waẓanna dāwūdu annamā fatannāhu fa-is'taghfara rabbahu wakharra rākiʿaw-wa-anāb
verses.translation: [David] said, "He has certainly wronged you in demanding your ewe [in addition] to his ewes. And indeed, many associates oppress one another, except for those who believe and do righteous deeds - and few are they." And David became certain that We had tried him, and he asked forgiveness of his Lord and fell down bowing [in prostration] and turned in repentance [to Allah].

verses.arabicText: فَغَفَرْنَا لَهُۥ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Faghafarnā lahu dhālika wa-inna lahu ʿindanā lazul'fā waḥus'na maābin
verses.translation: So We forgave him that; and indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.

verses.arabicText: يَٰدَاوُۥدُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَٰكَ خَلِيفَةًۭ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ شَدِيدٌۢ بِمَا نَسُوا۟ يَوْمَ ٱلْحِسَابِ
verses.transliteration: Yādāwūdu innā jaʿalnāka khalīfatan fī l-arḍi fa-uḥ'kum bayna n-nāsi bil-ḥaqi walā tattabiʿi l-hawā fayuḍillaka ʿan sabīli l-lahi inna alladhīna yaḍillūna ʿan sabīli l-lahi lahum ʿadhābun shadīdun bimā nasū yawma l-ḥisāb
verses.translation: [We said], "O David, indeed We have made you a successor upon the earth, so judge between the people in truth and do not follow [your own] desire, as it will lead you astray from the way of Allah." Indeed, those who go astray from the way of Allah will have a severe punishment for having forgotten the Day of Account.

verses.arabicText: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا بَٰطِلًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۚ فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.transliteration: Wamā khalaqnā s-samāa wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā bāṭilan dhālika ẓannu alladhīna kafarū fawaylul-lilladhīna kafarū mina n-nār
verses.translation: And We did not create the heaven and the earth and that between them aimlessly. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve, so woe to those who disbelieve from the Fire.

verses.arabicText: أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ كَٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ كَٱلْفُجَّارِ
verses.transliteration: Am najʿalu alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū ṣ-ṣāliḥāti kal-muf'sidīna fī l-arḍi am najʿalu l-mutaqīna kal-fujār
verses.translation: Or should we treat those who believe and do righteous deeds like corrupters in the land? Or should We treat those who fear Allah like the wicked?

verses.arabicText: كِتَٰبٌ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ إِلَيْكَ مُبَٰرَكٌۭ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوٓا۟ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
verses.transliteration: Kitābun anzalnāhu ilayka mubārakul-liyaddabbarū āyātihi waliyatadhakkara ulū l-albāb
verses.translation: [This is] a blessed Book which We have revealed to you, [O Muhammad], that they might reflect upon its verses and that those of understanding would be reminded.

verses.arabicText: وَوَهَبْنَا لِدَاوُۥدَ سُلَيْمَٰنَ ۚ نِعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
verses.transliteration: Wawahabnā lidāwūda sulaymāna niʿ'ma l-ʿabdu innahu awwābun
verses.translation: And to David We gave Solomon. An excellent servant, indeed he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allah].

verses.arabicText: إِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ ٱلصَّٰفِنَٰتُ ٱلْجِيَادُ
verses.transliteration: Idh ʿuriḍa ʿalayhi bil-ʿashiyi ṣ-ṣāfinātu l-jiyād
verses.translation: [Mention] when there were exhibited before him in the afternoon the poised [standing] racehorses.

verses.arabicText: فَقَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ ٱلْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّى حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِٱلْحِجَابِ
verses.transliteration: Faqāla innī aḥbabtu ḥubba l-khayri ʿan dhik'ri rabbī ḥattā tawārat bil-ḥijāb
verses.translation: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until the sun disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]."

verses.arabicText: رُدُّوهَا عَلَىَّ ۖ فَطَفِقَ مَسْحًۢا بِٱلسُّوقِ وَٱلْأَعْنَاقِ
verses.transliteration: Ruddūhā ʿalayya faṭafiqa masḥan bil-sūqi wal-aʿnāq
verses.translation: [He said], "Return them to me," and set about striking [their] legs and necks.

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَيْمَٰنَ وَأَلْقَيْنَا عَلَىٰ كُرْسِيِّهِۦ جَسَدًۭا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad fatannā sulaymāna wa-alqaynā ʿalā kur'siyyihi jasadan thumma anāb
verses.translation: And We certainly tried Solomon and placed on his throne a body; then he returned.

verses.arabicText: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَهَبْ لِى مُلْكًۭا لَّا يَنۢبَغِى لِأَحَدٍۢ مِّنۢ بَعْدِىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ
verses.transliteration: Qāla rabbi igh'fir lī wahab lī mul'kal-lā yanbaghī li-aḥadim-min baʿdī innaka anta l-wahāb
verses.translation: He said, "My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me. Indeed, You are the Bestower."

verses.arabicText: فَسَخَّرْنَا لَهُ ٱلرِّيحَ تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦ رُخَآءً حَيْثُ أَصَابَ
verses.transliteration: Fasakharnā lahu r-rīḥa tajrī bi-amrihi rukhāan ḥaythu aṣāb
verses.translation: So We subjected to him the wind blowing by his command, gently, wherever he directed,

verses.arabicText: وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّآءٍۢ وَغَوَّاصٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Wal-shayāṭīna kulla bannāiw-waghawwāṣin
verses.translation: And [also] the devils [of jinn] - every builder and diver

verses.arabicText: وَءَاخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِى ٱلْأَصْفَادِ
verses.transliteration: Waākharīna muqarranīna fī l-aṣfād
verses.translation: And others bound together in shackles.

verses.arabicText: هَٰذَا عَطَآؤُنَا فَٱمْنُنْ أَوْ أَمْسِكْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Hādhā ʿaṭāunā fa-um'nun aw amsik bighayri ḥisābin
verses.translation: [We said], "This is Our gift, so grant or withhold without account."

verses.arabicText: وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Wa-inna lahu ʿindanā lazul'fā waḥus'na maābin
verses.translation: And indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.

verses.arabicText: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ بِنُصْبٍۢ وَعَذَابٍ
verses.transliteration: Wa-udh'kur ʿabdanā ayyūba idh nādā rabbahu annī massaniya sh-shayṭānu binuṣ'biw-waʿadhābin
verses.translation: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment."

verses.arabicText: ٱرْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ ۖ هَٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌۢ بَارِدٌۭ وَشَرَابٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Ur'kuḍ birij'lika hādhā mugh'tasalun bāriduw-washarābun
verses.translation: [So he was told], "Strike [the ground] with your foot; this is a [spring for] a cool bath and drink."

verses.arabicText: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
verses.transliteration: Wawahabnā lahu ahlahu wamith'lahum maʿahum raḥmatam-minnā wadhik'rā li-ulī l-albāb
verses.translation: And We granted him his family and a like [number] with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding.

verses.arabicText: وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًۭا فَٱضْرِب بِّهِۦ وَلَا تَحْنَثْ ۗ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَٰهُ صَابِرًۭا ۚ نِّعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Wakhudh biyadika ḍigh'than fa-iḍ'rib bihi walā taḥnath innā wajadnāhu ṣābiran-niʿ'ma l-ʿabdu innahu awwābun
verses.translation: [We said], "And take in your hand a bunch [of grass] and strike with it and do not break your oath." Indeed, We found him patient, an excellent servant. Indeed, he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allah].

verses.arabicText: وَٱذْكُرْ عِبَٰدَنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ أُو۟لِى ٱلْأَيْدِى وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرِ
verses.transliteration: Wa-udh'kur ʿibādanā ib'rāhīma wa-is'ḥāqa wayaʿqūba ulī l-aydī wal-abṣār
verses.translation: And remember Our servants, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob - those of strength and [religious] vision.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّآ أَخْلَصْنَٰهُم بِخَالِصَةٍۢ ذِكْرَى ٱلدَّارِ
verses.transliteration: Innā akhlaṣnāhum bikhāliṣatin dhik'rā d-dār
verses.translation: Indeed, We chose them for an exclusive quality: remembrance of the home [of the Hereafter].

verses.arabicText: وَإِنَّهُمْ عِندَنَا لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصْطَفَيْنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ
verses.transliteration: Wa-innahum ʿindanā lamina l-muṣ'ṭafayna l-akhyār
verses.translation: And indeed they are, to Us, among the chosen and outstanding.

verses.arabicText: وَٱذْكُرْ إِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَٱلْيَسَعَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ وَكُلٌّۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ
verses.transliteration: Wa-udh'kur is'māʿīla wal-yasaʿa wadhā l-kif'li wakullum-mina l-akhyār
verses.translation: And remember Ishmael, Elisha and Dhul-Kifl, and all are among the outstanding.

verses.arabicText: هَٰذَا ذِكْرٌۭ ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Hādhā dhik'ruw-wa-inna lil'muttaqīna laḥus'na maābin
verses.translation: This is a reminder. And indeed, for the righteous is a good place of return

verses.arabicText: جَنَّٰتِ عَدْنٍۢ مُّفَتَّحَةًۭ لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَبْوَٰبُ
verses.transliteration: Jannāti ʿadnim-mufattaḥatan lahumu l-abwāb
verses.translation: Gardens of perpetual residence, whose doors will be opened to them.

verses.arabicText: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَٰكِهَةٍۢ كَثِيرَةٍۢ وَشَرَابٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Muttakiīna fīhā yadʿūna fīhā bifākihatin kathīratiw-washarābin
verses.translation: Reclining within them, they will call therein for abundant fruit and drink.

verses.arabicText: ۞ وَعِندَهُمْ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ أَتْرَابٌ
verses.transliteration: Waʿindahum qāṣirātu ṭ-ṭarfi atrābun
verses.translation: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances and of equal age.

verses.arabicText: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
verses.transliteration: Hādhā mā tūʿadūna liyawmi l-ḥisāb
verses.translation: This is what you, [the righteous], are promised for the Day of Account.

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَرِزْقُنَا مَا لَهُۥ مِن نَّفَادٍ
verses.transliteration: Inna hādhā lariz'qunā mā lahu min-nafādin
verses.translation: Indeed, this is Our provision; for it there is no depletion.

verses.arabicText: هَٰذَا ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلطَّٰغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَـَٔابٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Hādhā wa-inna lilṭṭāghīna lasharra maābin
verses.translation: This [is so]. But indeed, for the transgressors is an evil place of return -

verses.arabicText: جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا فَبِئْسَ ٱلْمِهَادُ
verses.transliteration: Jahannama yaṣlawnahā fabi'sa l-mihād
verses.translation: Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the resting place.

verses.arabicText: هَٰذَا فَلْيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمٌۭ وَغَسَّاقٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Hādhā falyadhūqūhu ḥamīmuw-waghassāqun
verses.translation: This - so let them taste it - is scalding water and [foul] purulence.

verses.arabicText: وَءَاخَرُ مِن شَكْلِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجٌ
verses.transliteration: Waākharu min shaklihi azwājun
verses.translation: And other [punishments] of its type [in various] kinds.

verses.arabicText: هَٰذَا فَوْجٌۭ مُّقْتَحِمٌۭ مَّعَكُمْ ۖ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ صَالُوا۟ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.transliteration: Hādhā fawjum-muq'taḥimun maʿakum lā marḥaban bihim innahum ṣālū n-nār
verses.translation: [Its inhabitants will say], "This is a company bursting in with you. No welcome for them. Indeed, they will burn in the Fire."

verses.arabicText: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ أَنتُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِكُمْ ۖ أَنتُمْ قَدَّمْتُمُوهُ لَنَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرَارُ
verses.transliteration: Qālū bal antum lā marḥaban bikum antum qaddamtumūhu lanā fabi'sa l-qarār
verses.translation: They will say, "Nor you! No welcome for you. You, [our leaders], brought this upon us, and wretched is the settlement."

verses.arabicText: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا مَن قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَٰذَا فَزِدْهُ عَذَابًۭا ضِعْفًۭا فِى ٱلنَّارِ
verses.transliteration: Qālū rabbanā man qaddama lanā hādhā fazid'hu ʿadhāban ḍiʿ'fan fī n-nār
verses.translation: They will say, "Our Lord, whoever brought this upon us - increase for him double punishment in the Fire."

verses.arabicText: وَقَالُوا۟ مَا لَنَا لَا نَرَىٰ رِجَالًۭا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ
verses.transliteration: Waqālū mā lanā lā narā rijālan kunnā naʿudduhum mina l-ashrār
verses.translation: And they will say, "Why do we not see men whom we used to count among the worst?

verses.arabicText: أَتَّخَذْنَٰهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا أَمْ زَاغَتْ عَنْهُمُ ٱلْأَبْصَٰرُ
verses.transliteration: Attakhadhnāhum sikh'riyyan am zāghat ʿanhumu l-abṣār
verses.translation: Is it [because] we took them in ridicule, or has [our] vision turned away from them?"

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَحَقٌّۭ تَخَاصُمُ أَهْلِ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.transliteration: Inna dhālika laḥaqqun takhāṣumu ahli n-nār
verses.translation: Indeed, that is truth - the quarreling of the people of the Fire.

verses.arabicText: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ مُنذِرٌۭ ۖ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَٰهٍ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّارُ
verses.transliteration: Qul innamā anā mundhiruw-wamā min ilāhin illā l-lahu l-wāḥidu l-qahār
verses.translation: Say, [O Muhammad], "I am only a warner, and there is not any deity except Allah, the One, the Prevailing.

verses.arabicText: رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفَّٰرُ
verses.transliteration: Rabbu s-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā l-ʿazīzu l-ghafār
verses.translation: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver."

verses.arabicText: قُلْ هُوَ نَبَؤٌا۟ عَظِيمٌ
verses.transliteration: Qul huwa naba-on ʿaẓīmun
verses.translation: Say, "It is great news

verses.arabicText: أَنتُمْ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضُونَ
verses.transliteration: Antum ʿanhu muʿ'riḍūn
verses.translation: From which you turn away.

verses.arabicText: مَا كَانَ لِىَ مِنْ عِلْمٍۭ بِٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰٓ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Mā kāna liya min ʿil'min bil-mala-i l-aʿlā idh yakhtaṣimūn
verses.translation: I had no knowledge of the exalted assembly [of angels] when they were disputing [the creation of Adam].

verses.arabicText: إِن يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ إِلَّآ أَنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ
verses.transliteration: Iy-yūḥā ilayya illā annamā anā nadhīrum-mubīnun
verses.translation: It has not been revealed to me except that I am a clear warner."

verses.arabicText: إِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًۭا مِّن طِينٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Idh qāla rabbuka lil'malāikati innī khāliqun basharam-min ṭīnin
verses.translation: [So mention] when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I am going to create a human being from clay.

verses.arabicText: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ
verses.transliteration: Fa-idhā sawwaytuhu wanafakhtu fīhi mir-rūḥī faqaʿū lahu sājidīn
verses.translation: So when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."

verses.arabicText: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fasajada l-malāikatu kulluhum ajmaʿūn
verses.translation: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely.

verses.arabicText: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ ٱسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Illā ib'līsa is'takbara wakāna mina l-kāfirīn
verses.translation: Except Iblees; he was arrogant and became among the disbelievers.

verses.arabicText: قَالَ يَٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَن تَسْجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقْتُ بِيَدَىَّ ۖ أَسْتَكْبَرْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْعَالِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qāla yāib'līsu mā manaʿaka an tasjuda limā khalaqtu biyadayya astakbarta am kunta mina l-ʿālīn
verses.translation: [Allah] said, "O Iblees, what prevented you from prostrating to that which I created with My hands? Were you arrogant [then], or were you [already] among the haughty?"

verses.arabicText: قَالَ أَنَا۠ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْهُ ۖ خَلَقْتَنِى مِن نَّارٍۢ وَخَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن طِينٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Qāla anā khayrum-min'hu khalaqtanī min-nārin wakhalaqtahu min ṭīnin
verses.translation: He said, "I am better than him. You created me from fire and created him from clay."

verses.arabicText: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Qāla fa-ukh'ruj min'hā fa-innaka rajīmun
verses.translation: [Allah] said, "Then get out of Paradise, for indeed, you are expelled.

verses.arabicText: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ لَعْنَتِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.transliteration: Wa-inna ʿalayka laʿnatī ilā yawmi d-dīn
verses.translation: And indeed, upon you is My curse until the Day of Recompense."

verses.arabicText: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qāla rabbi fa-anẓir'nī ilā yawmi yub'ʿathūn
verses.translation: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."

verses.arabicText: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qāla fa-innaka mina l-munẓarīn
verses.translation: [Allah] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved

verses.arabicText: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ
verses.transliteration: Ilā yawmi l-waqti l-maʿlūm
verses.translation: Until the Day of the time well-known."

verses.arabicText: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qāla fabiʿizzatika la-ugh'wiyannahum ajmaʿīn
verses.translation: [Iblees] said, "By your might, I will surely mislead them all

verses.arabicText: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
verses.transliteration: Illā ʿibādaka min'humu l-mukh'laṣīn
verses.translation: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."

verses.arabicText: قَالَ فَٱلْحَقُّ وَٱلْحَقَّ أَقُولُ
verses.transliteration: Qāla fal-ḥaqu wal-ḥaqa aqūl
verses.translation: [Allah] said, "The truth [is My oath], and the truth I say -

verses.arabicText: لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكَ وَمِمَّن تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.transliteration: La-amla-anna jahannama minka wamimman tabiʿaka min'hum ajmaʿīn
verses.translation: [That] I will surely fill Hell with you and those of them that follow you all together."

verses.arabicText: قُلْ مَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍۢ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ
verses.transliteration: Qul mā asalukum ʿalayhi min ajriw-wamā anā mina l-mutakalifīn
verses.translation: Say, [O Muhammad], "I do not ask you for the Qur'an any payment, and I am not of the pretentious

verses.arabicText: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.transliteration: In huwa illā dhik'rul-lil'ʿālamīn
verses.translation: It is but a reminder to the worlds.

verses.arabicText: وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُۥ بَعْدَ حِينٍۭ
verses.transliteration: Walataʿlamunna naba-ahu baʿda ḥīnin
verses.translation: And you will surely know [the truth of] its information after a time."
